title: buildzr scene graph, one file per level or authored view (buildzr.scene/2)
description: A fully laid-out level (landscape, the inside of one element) or authored view. Coordinates are LOCAL to the scene (y down), rounded to 0.01. Styles are resolved; renderers never consult the model's styles. Canonical bytes: json sort_keys, separators (',', ':'), ensure_ascii False, UTF-8, trailing newline. Design note v4, section C. Rules the schema cannot express are enforced by buildzr/site/check.py.

key.description: Scene key: 'landscape', 'e/<element path>' or 'v/<view key>'. index.json maps it to a file.

scope.description: null for landscape; element path for element; view key for view.

modelHash.description: modelHash of the model.json this scene was built from.

inputHash.description: sha256 of the canonical ELK input of the final pass for this scene (layoutOptions included).

fallback.description: Set when a documented fallback was used, e.g. 'port-continuity-stops-at-container'.

bounds.description: [minX, minY, width, height]. For level.kind = element this is EXACTLY the scoped element's own box in local coordinates (minX = minY = 0): the ports lie on its border and a parent frame maps it by translate + uniform scale. For landscape and view scenes: everything drawn, plus margin.

ports.description: Only for level.kind = element (empty otherwise). One per rolled-up edge of the PARENT scene that touches the scoped element; port.id equals that parent edge's id. Sorted by id.

nodes.description: Pre-order depth-first (parents before children). Siblings sorted by id.

edges.description: Rolled-up edges for this level, sorted by id.

num.description: Rounded to 0.01; integral values written without a fraction; -0 written as 0.

id.description: = the parent scene's edge id this port continues.

side.description: Border of bounds the port lies on (within 0.5 px).

text.description: Already wrapped by the build for the UNSCALED box width; renderers never re-wrap.

tier.description: 0 name, 1 type/technology, 2 description. Renderer hides tiers whose effective px (size x cumulative scale x zoom) < 6.

scene.description: Child scene key; its content is drawn inside this node's rect.

scale.description: Uniform scale. Child point (x, y) maps to (node.x + scale * (x - b.minX), node.y + scale * (y - b.minY)), b = child scene bounds; node.w = scale * b.w and node.h = scale * b.h within 0.5 px.

children.description: Direct child count (for the 'N containers' badge).

childType.description: Type of the children, e.g. 'Container', for the badge text.

id.description: Element path for role=element (same as model.json id). Boundary ids are 'group:<slug path>' or the element path of the boundary element.

role.description: boundary = enclosing box (group, or the scoped system/container in an authored view) with children and a corner label.

type.description: Person, SoftwareSystem, Container, Component, Group, ... Renderers ignore types they do not know.

parent.description: Enclosing boundary node id in THIS scene, or null.

anchor.description: 'top' is used on frame nodes so the label leaves the inside free.

frame.description: Present on nodes whose inside is a child scene (expandable). Only in landscape and element scenes.

port.description: Port id of this scene; the edge continues as the parent scene's edge with that id.

id.description: Opaque, unique in the scene. Convention: '<a>-><b>' with a port end written 'port:<port id>'.

points.description: Polyline in scene coordinates, from source border (or port) to target border (or port).

rels.description: model.json relationship ids this edge stands for, sorted.
